text:
rachel: Morning all — quick async check-in for today (doing the usual 3):
- What I did: shipped rollout for cache-key normalization (small API change + migration). Observability looks good in staging.
- Blockers: one failing e2e flake in dedupe flow that only shows up at high QPS, can't repro locally.
- Today: follow up on the flake, submit hotfix if we can root cause; pair with infra on canary ramp if stable.
- Ask: @sam can you spare 30m later to look at the e2e logs with me? pinged you in calendar.

sam: yep, 3pm works. I can also run the load repro script on the dedicated cluster.

tariq: nice work on the cache keys. quick FYI — I noticed the metric we added for prefix-hit-rate is missing tags in prod, should be an easy fix (forgot to include route_id). I'll open a PR.

jen: standup:
- What I did: landed versioned policy checks for private deploys (docs + tests).
- Blockers: waiting on legal to confirm wording for the audit log retention page.
- Today: finish the console UI tweaks and add integration test for ACLs.
- Ask: @alex can you review the UI PR when you have a mo? small CSS tweak + accessibility labels.

alex: will review after lunch. re: e2e flake — if you have stack traces paste them here or DM, I can try to correlate with the kernel logs from last night's maintenance.

rachel: thanks — I'll DM the traces. infra-bot: deploy-canary #cache-normalization started for pool-2 (canary=10%).

infra-bot: canary-health: 12m running, 0 errors, avg 82ms p95.

sam: ran repro script on dedicated — reproduced the higher-latency tail at ~1k rps, attaching the command I used:
```
./load-test --target=https://dedicated-pool-2.internal --concurrency=200 --rps=1000 --payload=tests/fixtures/dedupe.json
```
Logs show a spike in GC + a brief thread lock around the cache flush.

rachel: good catch. I'll try toggling the flush heuristic and re-run.

tariq: PR opened: #4823 adds the missing tag to prefix-hit-rate. also left a note on deployment impact.

jen: legal responded: "retention wording approved" — proceeding to merge. :tada:

alex: reviewed UI PR and left two tiny comments. nothing blocking.

rachel: summary/ask for the org:
- We're ramping canary slowly, currently healthy.
- If you see alerts from canary-channel in the next hour, please triage and ping @rachel or @sam.
- Small help request: can anyone in US-PST overlap volunteer for a 15m quick check at 2:45pm PT in case the repro triggers? appreciate it.

sam: I can cover 2:45-3:15pm.

jen: I can do 2:50-3:05pm.

rachel: perfect, thanks team. closing this thread — will post a quick follow-up if we need a hotfix. :raised_hands:
